guardrails.title: Help & Guidance
guardrails.requestedTitle: When to set the status to 'Consultation requested'
guardrails.requestedBody: This is to notify the client that you are requesting a consultation with them. You must add a note that specifies your request. You can proceed without a scheduled channel and date, but the client should be contacted in advance to book.
guardrails.bookedTitle: When to set the status to 'Consultation booked'
guardrails.bookedItemChannel: This is to notify that the consultation details have been finalised with the client with the date and channel set.
guardrails.bookedItemDatetime: Consultation channel & date/time must be set, link is optional
guardrails.completedTitle: When to set the status to 'Consultation completed'
guardrails.completedBody: Consultation has concluded. If successful, the next step is to prepare the case plan and requirements.

fields.link: Meeting link (optional but recommended for clients visibility)
